title: Hand-drawn sketch of a disc-shaped object with a dome on top
description:
RESTRICTED
CHECK-LIST - UNIDENTIFIED FLYING OBJECTS
Incident # 75


Date        13 Aug 47


Time        1300


Location        Smoke River Canyon (near Twin Falls) Idaho


Name of observer        A. C. Urie and two sons, Kenneth & Billy


Number of objects        1


Distance of object from observer        300 ft


Time in sight        momentary


Altitude        75 ft from the canyon floor - 300 ft away from observer
Level view afforded


Speed        1000 MPH


Direction of flight        East to West


Tactics        Road up and down over hills & hollows of canyon


Sound        swishing sound


Size        20 feet by 10 ft in thickness


Color        sky blue


Shape        oblong broad rimmed hat with low crown
inverted pie-plate


Exhaust trails        Exhaust [illegible] flame - a red tubular fiery glow at the
side of the top or hood.


Sketches or photographs        one


Manner of disappearance        disappeared behind hill


Remarks:        (over)


RESTRICTED
RESTRICTED
Urie had sent his sons to the river for some tops from his boat.  As they
were overdue he went to look for them, when he noticed some 300 feet away
some 75 feet in the air a sky-blue object silhouetted against the steep
wall of the canyon on the far side.  (The canyon is about 400 ft deep and
1200 ft across at that place.)  The object was traveling 75 feet in the air
(300 ft below the rim of the canyon) and so was plainly visible.  Urie
